meta.description: What the Subsidy Viability Report covers: the questions it answers, the project information it needs and how it connects to execution support.

hero.intro: A structured look at how subsidy and incentive options relate to your project, set out in a report you can review with your team and advisers.

items.1: Which subsidy or incentive schemes are relevant to this project's activity, location and stage?
items.2: How do the project facts compare with each scheme's published conditions?
items.3: Which parts of the investment or activity need particular attention?
items.4: What information and documents are needed before an application can be prepared?
items.5: What are the sensible next steps, and which of them need professional support?

inputs.heading: What we need from you
inputs.intro: The more clearly the project is described, the more specific the report can be.

items.1: What the business does and where the unit is, or will be, located
items.2: The stage of the project: planned, under construction or operating
items.3: The planned investment, such as land, building, plant and machinery
items.4: Existing registrations, approvals and any applications already made
items.5: Any scheme you are already considering

items.1: The schemes considered and why each is, or is not, relevant
items.2: A comparison of the project facts with the scheme conditions
items.3: A checklist of information and documents to gather
items.4: Points to confirm and risks to watch
items.5: Suggested next steps, with the official sources used

sample.heading: See what the report looks like
sample.label: Sample report - to be supplied by Rapid
sample.caption: A sample of the report will be shown here.

execution.heading: From report to execution
execution.body: The report is a starting point. If you decide to go ahead, Rapid can support the application, documents and follow-up for the scheme you choose, within an agreed scope.
execution.note: Scheme conditions are set by the issuing authority. Always check the official source.

community.heading: Get relevant updates in a Rapid group
community.intro: Choose the group that matches your work. Each group lists the kinds of updates its members receive.
community.separate: Joining a group does not create a channel partnership, and the adviser partnership journey has its own terms. Private WhatsApp contact with Rapid is separate:
community.usefulText: What changed? Who does it affect? What should the reader do, and by when? Include an official source.
